model_provenance: Actual audit performed using openai/gpt-6.1-sol after the harness switched from anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 because Anthropic quota was exhausted; the initial model had not completed an audit.

findings.message: Singular selection uses plural verb agreement: count=1 renders “1 चुने गए।” The selected tag is still understandable; this is a grammatical polish issue, not a wrong action or count.
findings.recommendation: Use an exact =1 ICU branch with “# चुना गया” and a plural/default branch with “# चुने गए”, preserving name and the second sentence.
findings.evidence: intl-messageformat with locale hi, count=1 and name=काम rendered “1 चुने गए। काम के तहत समूह बनाएँ।”

findings.message: “सभी बातचीत के लिए” omits the oblique plural ending before के लिए. Meaning and persistence scope remain clear.
findings.recommendation: Prefer “सभी बातचीतों के लिए सहेजा जाता है”.

checks.hashes: Both expected SHA-256 values matched the on-disk bytes immediately before receipt creation.
checks.baseline: Compared decoded JSON values against git HEAD for both EN and HI: 54 baseline keys each, zero changed or removed; formatting-only differences are excluded.
checks.coverage: Read all 73 English/Hindi pairs, including 19 additions; checked meaning, grammar, neutral/polite UI register, punctuation, dynamic argument semantics and static menu/toast length risk.
checks.icu: Existing @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser parsed all 73 pairs; AST argument-name sets matched for every pair. Existing intl-messageformat successfully formatted both locales at count 0,1,2,8,32: 730 formatted messages. Exercised existing plural branches in delete_description/remove_all and the simplified HI tag_usage count. Hindi tag_usage uses a compact count-plus-noun label; loss of English plural syntax does not lose an argument or quantity.
checks.reserved_identifier: Confirmed EN context explicitly requires the literal ASCII Untagged identifier to remain untranslated; HI preserves it.
checks.length_risk: No blocking static menu/toast length concern identified. Dynamic names remain variable length. No rendered-fit claim: rendered QA is explicitly outside this audit.
checks.scope: Hindi ui.chat.tags only. Application files, other locale receipts and ledger were not edited.

verdict: clean with minor follow-ups; TERMINAL. Zero BLOCKER and zero MAJOR.
